Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614458. Join assays, activities, compound_records, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614458, exact measurements (standard_relation '='), and non-null standard_value. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
